abstract: In short, the comparison of the arms gives these main findings. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.
